title_zh: 约定按作者亲历修改战后家庭书评

scenario.label_zh: 约定按作者亲历修改战后家庭书评
scenario.goal_zh: 区分回忆录的个人经历与普遍结论，并约定把书评限定在作者家庭

context_zh: 两位成人读书小组成员为一部虚构回忆录写简短书评。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: Your review makes the memoir sound like a history of every family in the city.

sentences.speaker: Dev
sentences.text: I meant to portray the uncertainty of post-war life. Have I made the claim too broad?

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: I think so. The author describes her own family waiting for her father to return, not a whole city’s experience.

sentences.speaker: Dev
sentences.text: Then I’ll say the book follows one family through those unsettled years.

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: That keeps the strength of the story without asking it to speak for everyone.

sentences.speaker: Dev
sentences.text: Agreed. I’ll make that change and keep the example about her father.
